value.rationale: An exact probability distribution for the natural single-deletion ambiguity of a composition-window nanopore read sequence is available for every alphabet/window length; the same-source covariance across all read lengths is identically zero despite nonindependence, and the exact forest criterion explains the dependence transition. This is a structurally motivated complete statistical characterization, useful for setting up average-case read ambiguity models rather than a small arbitrary computation. No optimal coding theorem is claimed.
